visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a well-lit indoor kitchen with a man leaning his head on a wooden table. He is wearing a green textured shirt and has long, dark curly hair, looking visibly exhausted. He is lazily whisking eggs in a translucent yellow bowl. (2) A sharp cut shows a close-up of a white cup of instant noodles. A hand pours a whole yellow custard pudding from a small dish into the steaming noodle broth. (3) The scene shifts back to the man who is now using green chopsticks to stir the pudding into the cup. The clear broth gradually transforms into a milky, creamy white liquid as the pudding dissolves. (4) The man takes a large sip of the soup, and his facial expression changes from exhaustion to dramatic shock. He looks into the camera with wide eyes and open mouth, gesturing excitedly. (5) He introduces a second dish in a clear bowl, showing dry noodles topped with a soft-boiled egg, a slice of chicken, and a dark sauce being poured over it. (6) A series of quick cuts show stacked cups of 'Ah Q' instant noodles on the table in front of a chalkboard background. The man continues to eat and talk with high energy, ending with a cheerful laugh.
